messages:
marta: Starting onboarding for orca-mini-bleu-v2 to hosted catalog. Need weights location, tokenizer notes, runtime config validation, and a short customer blurb for release notes. Any blockers?

liam: Wt: s3://redwood-models/hosted/orca-mini-bleu-v2/ — manifest.json + shards. CI tag: 2024-11-22-orca-v2. Bucket perms set for hosted services. :white_check_mark:

marta: Great. Tokenizer behavior: I hit OOVs in smoke tests. Do we have tokenizer files and any special tokens?

liam: Tokenizer assets uploaded alongside weights: tokenizer.json and merges.txt. Exported from HF but BOS token renamed from <|startoftext|> to <s_bos>. The serving runtime currently maps <s_bos> -> "" by default but we should declare it in model config to be explicit.

sophia: @marta can you paste a minimal config snippet for docs + a few capability bullets? Also a short note about known quirks for the customer-facing release.

marta: Minimal model config we validated locally:
```
model:
  id: orca-mini-bleu-v2
  weights_url: s3://redwood-models/hosted/orca-mini-bleu-v2/manifest.json
  tokenizer:
    type: hf_bytelevel
    vocab: tokenizer.json
    merges: merges.txt
    bos_token: <s_bos>
runtime:
  max_seq: 2048
  kv_cache_shards: 2
  quantization: int8
  special_token_map:
    "<s_bos>": ""  # map to standard BOS in runtime
```

liam: Infra note: int8 path requires kernel variant `kv_int8_v2` on GPU nodes. Canary fleet has it; if missing, runtime downgrades to float32 and an alert fires.

dryan (deploy-bot): Canary deploy started for orca-mini-bleu-v2 on pool hosted-canary-2 — job 12531. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/12531

ryan: For the blurb we'll need P50/P95 latency targets and a "best for" line. Suggest "best for low-latency assistants and lightweight reranking". Also flag tokenizer mapping so self-hosters or custom tokenizers don't get unexpected truncation.

marta: Capability notes for docs:
- Strengths: efficient instruction following, strong few-shot performance on code examples, lower cost than full-size Orca variants.
- Known quirks: requires explicit bos_token mapping; tokenization may count ~+8% tokens on emoji-heavy inputs; mild repetition past ~1024 tokens.

sophia: Draft release blurb:
"Orca Mini Bleu v2 is now available on Redwood hosted API. It's a cost-efficient, low-latency instruction model tuned for assistant and reranking workflows. Note: this model uses a nonstandard BOS token (`<s_bos>`). Redwood remaps it for hosted usage, but if you bring your own tokenizer or self-host, map `<s_bos>` to the standard BOS token to avoid off-by-one tokenization issues."

liam: Infra approves. Add a short troubleshooting tip for 403s when fetching weights: `aws s3api get-object --bucket redwood-models --key hosted/orca-mini-bleu-v2/manifest.json` will return 403 if IAM role lacks s3:GetObject.

marta: Action items:
- @sophia publish release note + model page with config snippet (ETA: EOD)
- @liam finish canary and confirm kernel variant on broader pool (ETA: +2h)
- @ryan finalize marketing blurb and comms (ETA: EOD)
- i'll run a tokenizer sweep and push eval csv

sophia: I'll post the announcement to #announcements after final approval. :memo:

liam: Canary passed perf checks; kernel present on canary nodes. Will promote after warmup.

marta: Eval summary: emoji-heavy chats show ~+8% token delta, otherwise performance stable. Uploading CSV to artifacts.

ryan: 👍 Ping me when announcement is live and i'll coordinate external comms.

marta: Thanks all. Marking thread resolved unless any new issues come up. :rocket:
